goal.objective: Execute the already-validated TV/TVC resident operational proof on the existing sovereign host without granting credential authority to heartbeat or expanding G18 authority.
success_predicates: an already-local TV tree has exact HEAD e0d102a8c187c059754eced9ac017fdb056a0222
an already-local TVC tree contains rootless activation merge e4bef703b4d6ccad858459ec502637c598948c42
the admitted /run/stegverse signing credential is consumed only by TVC systemd LoadCredential and never by the worker
runtime_execution_observed=true with a retained TVC runtime receipt path and proof SHA-256
failure_predicates: worker reads, hashes, logs, copies or transports signing credential bytes
worker fetches TV or TVC source from the network
hosted CI, GitHub, Render, Vercel or Cloudflare is accepted as runtime execution
TV source HEAD differs from the exact authorized commit
TVC rootless activation source is absent
a BLOCKED dispatcher result is converted to success
G18 claim/fence or authority is reused or expanded
authority_ceiling: no source fetch or source mutation

activation.recheck_trigger: each admitted worker cycle while unfinished

completion.next_authorized_action: WorkerCoordinator assigns a fresh claim/fence to the dedicated adapter. The worker observes only already-local TV/TVC trees, invokes TVC preflight and then activation in systemd-user mode, and persists only the secret-free result identity.

block.block_reason: Real local TV/TVC source, readable admitted /run/stegverse credential, or systemd-user execution may still be unavailable; any such condition remains BLOCKED and is rechecked without chat authority.
block.recheck_trigger: each admitted worker cycle while unfinished
block.escalation_condition: source mismatch, forbidden hosted runtime, credential transport attempt, or authority expansion
